source: MediaPipe Holistic landmarks from INCLUDE dataset clips (Sridhar, Ganesan, Kumar, Khapra; AI4Bharat / IIT Madras), CC BY 4.0. Face points removed. HELLO uses the 1080p re-extraction.
layout: per frame: 8 pose points (L/R shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip), 21 left-hand, 21 right-hand; x,y,z int16 = value*1e4; 32767 = not detected
